:::{.definition data-title="Vague Convergence"}

The sequence of distribution functions $F_{n}$ converges vaguely to $F$
($F_{n}\stackrel{v}{\to}F$), if for every finite interval of continuity
$I=(a,b]$ of $F$ (i.e. $a,b \in \mathcal{C}(F)$), we have $F_{n}(I)\to F(I)$.

:::
